'''Brejik's Run''' was an area in the [[Tularan Marsh]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Before the [[Destruction of Taris]], the [[Tarisian Season Opener]] took place on a track in the area, and the section of the Marsh known as [[Brejik]]'s Run was littered with the wreckage of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bikes]] that had been used in the race.
